title: Genuine Representations Of Central Covers
body_html:
Genuine Representations Of Central Covers

Let $\widetilde G$ be a $Z$-cover of $G$, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let

$$ \alpha:Z\to R^\times $$

be a character. A smooth $R[\widetilde G]$-module $(\pi,V)$ is $\alpha$-genuine if

$$ \pi(z)=\alpha(z)\operatorname{id}_V \qquad (z\in Z). $$

The category of such modules is denoted

$$ \operatorname{Rep}_R^{\alpha\text{-gen}}(\widetilde G). $$

If $H\subset G$ is a subgroup over which the cover splits and a splitting $\iota_H:H\to\widetilde H$ is chosen, restriction along $\iota_H$ gives an equivalence between $\alpha$-genuine representations of $\widetilde H$ and ordinary representations of $H$. If the splitting is unique, the draft writes the ordinary representation as $\sigma|_H$ without further choices.
